Container.Name: nod-workspace-unraid
Container.Overview:
Nod (5 of 6): sandbox where Nod runs commands and works with files for your sessions. It shares the firewalled network of nod-workspace-network, so it can reach the public internet but not your LAN, Tailscale or other containers. Unofficial community packaging, not affiliated with n8n GmbH.
Keep the container name unchanged: nod-server and nod-runtime look it up by name. The Workspaces path must be the same host folder as in nod-server.
Container.Requires: nod-workspace-network must be installed and running first. Part of the Nod app: install all six nod-* templates.

Config.Name: Workspaces
Config.Description: Session workspaces. Must be the same host folder as Workspaces in nod-server.

Config.Name: Workspace tools
Config.Description: Home folder for tools Nod installs in the workspace.
